title: Girplan Spiritleech
summary: A beastlord quest calls the Girplan Spiritleech and a ring of spiritminions.
overview: A beastlord quest calls the Girplan Spiritleech and a ring of spiritminions.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Have the group prepared before the quest hand-in to Yerika Sisslak.
The spawn sequence creates eleven spiritminions around the boss.
Collect the surrounding adds before they overwhelm the group and finish the spirit leech.
